title: CT findings: liver metastases and enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes
description: Contrast CT with radiologist segmentations of the findings themselves: three colorectal liver metastases with the liver and portal vein (Colorectal-Liver-Metastases, DICOM SEG), and two chest CTs in which every abnormal mediastinal lymph node (estimated short axis > 1 cm) is segmented (Mediastinal-Lymph-Node-SEG, 'Fully Annotated'). Three different patients.

referenceTargets.teachingNote: LNQ2023 'Fully Annotated' case: per the collection description, all mediastinal lymph nodes considered abnormal (estimated short axis larger than 1 cm) were segmented by expert annotators. The challenge paper notes that the visual short-axis estimate is error-prone near the 1 cm threshold. Patients were scanned during treatment for various cancers; the diagnosis behind the nodes is not given here.
